purpose: Measure engineering-design attainment without collapsing unlike capabilities into a single opaque leaderboard number.

admissionGate.label: Submission admission
checks: launch, packet, bundle, prompt, execution-contract and fairness digests match
submission manifest is readable and schema-valid
all submitted paths are safe and all declared hashes match
no prohibited executable, macro, external link, credential or network-dependent payload reaches the evaluator
the bundle addresses this benchmark rather than another task
admissionGate.note: Missing engineering content is not an A0 failure. It remains measurable as partial attainment.

baselineGates.label: Evidence completeness
checks: declared output coverage is reported
required neutral artifacts can be opened or are explicitly marked missing
requirement and evidence references are non-dangling

baselineGates.label: Geometry and kinematics
checks: the hash-bound static validator passes its published STEP-envelope and kinematic-manifest checks
base interface and cell envelope compliance are evidence-backed against the complete fixed geometry
required poses, paths, singularities, self-collision and cell collision are evaluated at declared fidelity rather than inferred from a static validator pass
gripper opening states and workpiece states are represented

baselineGates.label: Grasp and workpiece integrity
checks: all baseline workpieces have a permitted grasp
opening range, jaw travel and retention load path are feasible
normal operation, emergency deceleration and loss-of-power retention are evaluated
contact pressure and prohibited-surface constraints are respected, including WP-C-CONTACT-001

baselineGates.label: Mechanical capacity
checks: governing static, dynamic, emergency and loss-of-power cases are defined
motors, reducers, brakes, bearings, fasteners, links and gripper transmission have traceable margins
fatigue, wear and duty assumptions are stated with uncertainty
loads propagate from workpiece contact to floor interface without an unexplained break and use the fixed FND-ANCH-001 anchor/foundation lower-bound model

baselineGates.label: Accuracy and tolerance
checks: mechanical and common-control error contributions are separated
datum, backlash, compliance, thermal, calibration and assembly effects are allocated
critical stack-ups close against the supplied acceptance limits
claims are reproducible from submitted evidence; static RSS arithmetic is not treated as a physical repeatability pass

baselineGates.label: Manufacturing, assembly and service
checks: critical manufactured parts have material, process, datum, tolerance and inspection definitions
assembly sequence and tool access are feasible
wear parts, bearings, brakes, drives, fingers and utilities can be serviced
BOM and CAD are mutually consistent

baselineGates.label: Mechanical safety
checks: brake and loss-of-power holding capacity meet declared fault loads
gravity and stored-energy motion are controlled
mechanical stops, maintenance support and residual-energy release are defined
pinch and crush hazards have a mechanical control or an explicit integrator interface
residual risks are not misrepresented as certification

qualificationRules.baselineQualified: B1 through B6 are pass; B0 is reported separately
qualificationRules.changeQualified: the changed design independently passes change-context B1 through B6

checkpoints.label: Initial plan frozen
checkpoints.evidence: all disclosed input hashes and launch bindings verified; initial requirements, assumptions, alternatives and verification plan frozen

checkpoints.label: System concept selected
checkpoints.evidence: requirements trace, evaluated alternatives, integrated arm/gripper architecture and verification strategy receipt

checkpoints.label: Embodiment established
checkpoints.evidence: topology, frames, joints, workspace, powered gripper, neutral CAD/STEP, motion manifest and structured BOM receipt

checkpoints.label: Critical verification established
checkpoints.evidence: loads, drives, grasp retention, structure, accuracy, production definition, safety and service evidence receipt

checkpoints.label: Baseline submission sealed
checkpoints.evidence: complete neutral handoff, requirement-linked verification record and immutable baseline submission receipt

checkpoints.label: Change response sealed
checkpoints.evidence: pre-edit impact analysis plus changed-design receipt

anchors.meaning: No credible engineering case: absent, contradicted, unsafe, or unsupported by inspectable evidence.
Fragmentary concept evidence: important interfaces or assumptions are missing and conclusions are not reproducible.
Plausible preliminary design: principal decisions and calculations exist, but coverage, integration, uncertainty, or production definition remains materially incomplete.
Complete and traceable engineering design: requirements, decisions, analyses and production evidence are mutually consistent and independently reproducible.
Release-quality engineering evidence: independent checks support the design, uncertainty and failure behavior are controlled, and the evidence predicts common analysis or test outcomes.

dimensions.label: Kinematics, workspace and cycle feasibility
evidenceFocus: published static neutral-handoff validation and evidence-backed trajectory feasibility

dimensions.label: Load path, structure, drives and life
Mass, cost and energy Pareto quality

reviewProtocol.normalization: Host-generated neutral renders, normalized BOM tables and evidence sheets; candidate identity and free-form metadata are withheld.
reviewProtocol.adjudication: A third independent rater is required when any dimension differs by more than one ordinal level or when a gate result conflicts.
reviewProtocol.dimensionConsensus: median with observed minimum and maximum retained as the score interval
reviewProtocol.automaticEvidence: Automatic checks and common analyses remain separately visible and do not silently override an expert rating.

longitudinalRules.repeatedRuns: Report every run and a model-level median/range; the official repeat count is fixed in the launch execution profile.

compositeScore.reason: The ten-dimensional ordinal vector, qualification state, raw metrics and uncertainty are the official result. No uncalibrated weighting is used.
